recruitment_manoeuvre_detail.value: RMs were performed in a stepwise fashion. The patient’s ventilatory mode was switched to pressure control ventilation, with PEEP of 15 cm H2O, respiratory rate of 10 breaths/min, inspiratory/expiratory ratio of 1:1, and a pressure control level of +15 cm H2O. Every 30 seconds, PEEP was increased by 5 cm H2O. We progressively increased PEEP to 30 cm H2O + 15 cm H2O of pressure control. The total duration of the RM was 2 minutes.

provenance.quote: RMs were performed in a stepwise fashion. The patient’s ventilatory mode was switched to pressure control ventilation, with PEEP of 15 cm H2O, respiratory rate of 10 breaths/min, inspiratory/expiratory ratio of 1:1, and a pressure control level of +15 cm H2O. Every 30 seconds, PEEP was increased by 5 cm H2O. We progressively increased PEEP to 30 cm H2O + 15 cm H2O of pressure control. The total duration of the RM was 2 minutes.
provenance.location: p. 301, Material and Methods, PEEP Titration Techniques and RMs, RM

provenance.quote: Patients were ventilated with a tidal volume of 6.6 ± 1.2 mL/kg of ideal body weight, respiratory rate of 22.6 ± 6.8 breaths/min, minute volume ventilation of 9.8 ± 3.3 L/min, and an inspired oxygen fraction of 0.55 ± 0.09.

protocol_deviations.value: ZEEP maneuver was performed only on four patients, as deemed safe by the attending physician. In one patient, desaturation prevented performing the EELV measurement at ZEEP. Head of bed elevation to 30 degrees was not feasible in two patients (one due to hemodialysis catheter dysfunction, one required mandatory supine positioning after trauma surgery).

subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ARDS excluded by inclusion criteria. Obesity required (BMI >35). Timing of intervention was not reported from intubation or ICU admission; unclear timing subgroup.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: Checked against mgh_lung_rescue cluster: registration NCT02105220 differs from Fumagalli (NCT02503241) and Florio; enrolment period not reported; eligibility excludes ARDS whereas Fumagalli/Florio require ARDS. No overlap confirmed.
